title: Prediction of hospitalization using artificial intelligence for urgent patients in the emergency department
summary: Neural-network models predicted hospital admission from triage data for 282,971 urgent visits; the retrospective single-center validation supports this specific disposition task.
ai_technology: Three-layer neural network with batch normalization and sigmoid output

evidence.tested: Neural-network models predicted hospital admission from triage data for 282,971 urgent visits; the retrospective single-center validation supports this specific disposition task.
evidence.unknown: Affiliation was not available in the reviewed primary bibliographic metadata. Publication status could not be established from the reviewed primary bibliographic metadata.
evidence.ai_role: The neural network maps triage variables to hospital-admission likelihood; the study evaluated it on a held-out split of urgent emergency visits.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
